data.one_liner: Easily localize Flutter apps using JSON files with dynamic locale switching and persistent storage.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to translate a Flutter app into multiple languages using local JSON asset files. It provides widgets and extensions to change app locales dynamically at runtime and automatically saves the selected language preference.
use_when: You want to manage app localizations using JSON files stored in assets.
Users need to change the app language dynamically within the UI without restarting.
You want to remember the user's selected language across app restarts.
avoid_when: You require compile-time type-safe keys via code generation.
Your localization requires complex ICU message format features not handled by simple JSON assets.
strengths: Runtime locale switching with automatic persistence
Handy extensions and helper widgets like LocaleText
weaknesses: No compile-time verification of localization keys
Relies on JSON asset loading rather than native ARB/Intl code generation
data.setup_notes: Add json files in assets/locales/, declare them in pubspec.yaml, initialize Locales in main(), and wrap MaterialApp with LocaleBuilder.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular alternative for JSON/YAML-based localization with easy setup.
